3	
4	import { IVRFV2PlusWrapper } from "@chainlink/contracts/src/v0.8/vrf/dev/interfaces/IVRFV2PlusWrapper.sol";
5	import { IERC20 } from "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
6	import { IERC721 } from "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC721/IERC721.sol";
7	
8	/// @title raffle.fun Raffle Interface
9	/// @author heesho
10	/// @notice Defines one autonomous NFT raffle using fixed-price USDC entries and one transferable ERC-721 ticket per
11	///         purchase.
12	/// @dev Ticket IDs are sequential. Each ticket stores one inclusive uint128 entry range and remains a transferable
13	///      bearer claim until its owner atomically burns it for redemption or refund. The immutable quote token is trusted
14	///      canonical six-decimal USDC with standard, non-rebasing, fee-free transfers. Supported prizes are honest,
15	///      standards-compliant ERC-721s.
16	/// @custom:version 1.0.0
17	interface IRaffle {
18	    // Types
19	
20	    /// @notice The single authoritative raffle lifecycle and economic result.
21	    enum Status {
22	        /// @notice The clone is initialized and waiting for the factory to escrow the configured prize.
23	        AwaitingPrize,
24	        /// @notice The prize is escrowed and entry sales or post-sale draw initiation are available.
25	        Active,
26	        /// @notice A Chainlink VRF request was accepted and its callback window is open.
27	        Drawing,
28	        /// @notice The reserve was met and the winning ticket may redeem the prize NFT.
29	        NftWon,
30	        /// @notice The reserve was missed and the winning ticket may redeem its cash allocation.
31	        CashWon,
32	        /// @notice Full ticket refunds are enabled and the sponsor may recover the prize NFT.
33	        Refunding
34	    }
35	
36	    /// @notice Complete clone-specific configuration supplied once by the canonical factory.
37	    /// @param sponsor Prize depositor and empty-raffle cancellation authority.
38	    /// @param sponsorRecipient Immutable recipient of sponsor quote proceeds and any returned prize.
39	    /// @param protocolTreasury Immutable recipient of protocol fees.
40	    /// @param prizeToken Standards-compliant ERC-721 prize contract.
41	    /// @param prizeTokenId Token ID of the prize escrowed by this raffle.
42	    /// @param raffleId One-based canonical factory identifier for this raffle.
43	    /// @param reserveEntries Global raw entry-count threshold selecting the NFT outcome when met or exceeded.
44	    /// @param endTime Unix timestamp, in seconds, at which entry sales end exclusively.
45	    struct RaffleInitParams {
46	        address sponsor;
47	        address sponsorRecipient;
48	        address protocolTreasury;
49	        address prizeToken;
50	        uint256 prizeTokenId;
51	        uint256 raffleId;
52	        uint128 reserveEntries;
53	        uint64 endTime;
54	    }
55	
56	    // Events
57	
58	    /// @notice Emitted when the factory deposits the configured prize and activates the raffle.
59	    /// @param prizeToken ERC-721 contract of the deposited prize.
60	    /// @param prizeTokenId Token ID of the deposited prize.
61	    /// @param sponsor Address that deposited the prize through the factory.
62	    event PrizeDeposited(address indexed prizeToken, uint256 indexed prizeTokenId, address indexed sponsor);
63	
64	    /// @notice Emitted when a buyer pays for entries and one range ticket is minted.
65	    /// @param buyer Address that paid the six-decimal quote-token amount.
66	    /// @param recipient Address that received the newly minted ticket.
67	    /// @param ticketId Sequential ticket ID assigned to the purchase.
68	    /// @param firstEntry First global raffle entry represented by the ticket, inclusive.
69	    /// @param lastEntry Last global raffle entry represented by the ticket, inclusive.
70	    /// @param entryCount Number of entries represented by the ticket.
71	    /// @param grossAmount Raw six-decimal quote-token units paid, equal to `entryCount * ENTRY_PRICE`.
72	    event TicketPurchased(
73	        address indexed buyer,
74	        address indexed recipient,
75	        uint256 indexed ticketId,
76	        uint128 firstEntry,
77	        uint128 lastEntry,
78	        uint128 entryCount,
79	        uint256 grossAmount
80	    );
81	
82	    /// @notice Emitted when the raffle pays for and records its one Chainlink VRF request.
83	    /// @param requestId Wrapper-assigned request identifier.
84	    /// @param requester Address that initiated and funded the request.
85	    /// @param fee Native-token wei actually paid to the wrapper for the request.
86	    /// @param excessReturned Native-token wei returned to the requester after paying the actual fee.
87	    /// @param drawRequestedAt Unix timestamp, in seconds, when the request was accepted.
88	    /// @param callbackDeadline Exclusive Unix-timestamp deadline for accepting the authenticated callback.
89	    event DrawRequested(
90	        uint256 indexed requestId,
91	        address indexed requester,
92	        uint256 fee,
93	        uint256 excessReturned,
94	        uint256 drawRequestedAt,
95	        uint256 callbackDeadline
96	    );
97	
98	    /// @notice Emitted when an authenticated, ABI-decodable callback cannot resolve the raffle.
99	    /// @param receivedRequestId Request ID supplied by the wrapper callback.
100	    /// @param expectedRequestId Request ID currently recorded by the raffle, or zero before request persistence.
101	    /// @param status Current raffle status when the callback is ignored.
102	    event VrfCallbackIgnored(uint256 indexed receivedRequestId, uint256 indexed expectedRequestId, Status status);
103	
104	    /// @notice Emitted when an authenticated callback selects the winning entry and final result.
105	    /// @param requestId Request ID that produced the accepted randomness.
106	    /// @param winningEntry Selected one-based global entry number in `[1,totalEntries]`.
107	    /// @param result Final `NftWon` or `CashWon` result.
108	    event RaffleResolved(uint256 indexed requestId, uint128 indexed winningEntry, Status indexed result);
109	
110	    /// @notice Emitted when the raffle enters the full-refund branch.
111	    /// @param finalizer Address that enabled refunds.
112	    /// @param remainingRefundLiability Raw six-decimal quote-token units initially available for ticket refunds.
113	    event RefundsEnabled(address indexed finalizer, uint256 remainingRefundLiability);
114	
115	    /// @notice Emitted when the winning ticket is proven and all terminal quote-token liabilities are allocated.
116	    /// @param ticketId Ticket proven to contain the selected winning entry.
117	    /// @param settler Address that performed permissionless settlement.
118	    /// @param result Final `NftWon` or `CashWon` result.
119	    /// @param cashAmount Raw six-decimal quote-token units allocated to the cash winner; zero for `NftWon`.
120	    /// @param protocolFee Raw six-decimal quote-token units allocated to the treasury, rounded down from gross sales.
121	    /// @param sponsorAmount Raw six-decimal quote-token units allocated to the sponsor recipient as the remainder.
122	    event WinningTicketSettled(
123	        uint256 indexed ticketId,
124	        address indexed settler,
125	        Status indexed result,
126	        uint256 cashAmount,
127	        uint256 protocolFee,
128	        uint256 sponsorAmount
129	    );
130	
131	    /// @notice Emitted when the winning ticket owner burns the ticket and receives the corresponding prize.
132	    /// @param ticketId Burned winning ticket ID.
133	    /// @param winner Ticket owner that received the prize at redemption time.
134	    /// @param result Final `NftWon` or `CashWon` result.
135	    /// @param cashAmount Raw six-decimal quote-token units paid for `CashWon`; zero for `NftWon`.
136	    /// @param prizeToken ERC-721 prize contract for `NftWon`; the zero address for `CashWon`.
137	    /// @param prizeTokenId ERC-721 prize token ID for `NftWon`; zero for `CashWon`.
138	    event WinningTicketRedeemed(
139	        uint256 indexed ticketId,
140	        address indexed winner,
141	        Status indexed result,
142	        uint256 cashAmount,
143	        address prizeToken,
144	        uint256 prizeTokenId
145	    );
146	
147	    /// @notice Emitted when an owner burns one or more tickets for a full quote-token refund.
148	    /// @param owner Ticket owner that burned the tickets and received the refund.
149	    /// @param ticketQuantity Number of tickets burned in this transaction.
150	    /// @param entryQuantity Aggregate number of entries represented by the burned tickets.
151	    /// @param amount Raw six-decimal quote-token units refunded, equal to `entryQuantity * ENTRY_PRICE`.
152	    /// @param remainingRefundLiability Raw six-decimal quote-token units still claimable after this refund.
153	    event TicketsRefunded(
154	        address indexed owner,
155	        uint256 ticketQuantity,
156	        uint256 entryQuantity,
157	        uint256 amount,
158	        uint256 remainingRefundLiability
159	    );
160	
161	    /// @notice Emitted when the complete current sponsor balance is released to its immutable recipient.
162	    /// @param caller Address that triggered the permissionless release.
163	    /// @param recipient Immutable sponsor recipient that received the payment.
164	    /// @param amount Raw six-decimal quote-token units paid.
165	    event SponsorProceedsReleased(address indexed caller, address indexed recipient, uint256 amount);
166	
167	    /// @notice Emitted when the complete current protocol-fee balance is released to the immutable treasury.
168	    /// @param caller Address that triggered the permissionless release.
169	    /// @param treasury Immutable protocol treasury that received the payment.
170	    /// @param amount Raw six-decimal quote-token units paid.
171	    event ProtocolFeesReleased(address indexed caller, address indexed treasury, uint256 amount);
172	
173	    /// @notice Emitted when the escrowed prize is returned after a cash result or refund transition.
174	    /// @param caller Address that triggered the permissionless release.
175	    /// @param recipient Immutable sponsor recipient that received the prize.
176	    /// @param prizeToken ERC-721 contract of the returned prize.
177	    /// @param prizeTokenId Token ID of the returned prize.
178	    event SponsorPrizeReleased(
179	        address indexed caller, address indexed recipient, address indexed prizeToken, uint256 prizeTokenId
180	    );
181	
182	    // Errors
183	
184	    /// @notice Raised when a caller other than the immutable factory attempts clone initialization.
185	    error OnlyFactory();
186	
187	    /// @notice Raised when initialization is attempted more than once or on the locked implementation.
188	    error AlreadyInitialized();
189	
190	    /// @notice Raised when a required address is the zero address.
191	    error ZeroAddress();
192	
193	    /// @notice Raised when an operation is unavailable in the current lifecycle state.
194	    /// @param actual Current raffle status.
195	    error InvalidStatus(Status actual);
196	
197	    /// @notice Raised when an ERC-721 receiver callback does not exactly match the configured factory prize deposit.
198	    /// @param token ERC-721 contract that invoked the receiver callback.
199	    /// @param tokenId Token ID supplied by the callback.
200	    /// @param from Address identified as the previous token owner.
201	    /// @param operator Address identified as the transfer operator.
202	    error UnexpectedPrize(address token, uint256 tokenId, address from, address operator);
203	
204	    /// @notice Raised when an entry purchase is submitted at or after the exclusive sale end.
205	    /// @param endTime Exclusive sale-end Unix timestamp, in seconds.
206	    /// @param currentTime Current block Unix timestamp, in seconds.
207	    error SaleEnded(uint256 endTime, uint256 currentTime);
208	
209	    /// @notice Raised when an entry ticket would be minted to the zero address.
210	    error InvalidRecipient();
211	
212	    /// @notice Raised when a purchase requests no entries.
213	    error ZeroEntryCount();
214	
215	    /// @notice Raised when a purchase would exceed the `uint128` global entry-number representation.
216	    /// @param totalEntries Current global sold-entry count.
217	    /// @param requestedEntries Prospective entry count requested by the purchase.
218	    error TotalEntriesOverflow(uint128 totalEntries, uint128 requestedEntries);
219	
220	    /// @notice Raised when a refund batch is empty or exceeds the bounded ticket limit.
221	    /// @param quantity Number of supplied ticket IDs.
222	    /// @param maximum Maximum ticket IDs accepted per refund transaction.
223	    error InvalidTicketBatchSize(uint256 quantity, uint256 maximum);
224	
225	    /// @notice Raised when a quote-token claim targets a known protocol destination that could strand the claim.
226	    /// @param destination Rejected payout recipient.
227	    error InvalidQuoteDestination(address destination);
228	
229	    /// @notice Raised when a draw request is submitted before the sale end.
230	    /// @param endTime Exclusive sale-end Unix timestamp, in seconds.
231	    /// @param currentTime Current block Unix timestamp, in seconds.
232	    error RaffleNotEnded(uint256 endTime, uint256 currentTime);
233	
234	    /// @notice Raised when a draw request is submitted at or after the exclusive request deadline.
235	    /// @param deadline Exclusive draw-request Unix-timestamp deadline, in seconds.
236	    /// @param currentTime Current block Unix timestamp, in seconds.
237	    error DrawRequestWindowExpired(uint256 deadline, uint256 currentTime);
238	
239	    /// @notice Raised when draw initiation is attempted for a raffle with zero sold entries.
240	    error NoEntriesSold();
241	
242	    /// @notice Raised when refunds are requested before the applicable liveness deadline.
243	    /// @param deadline Unix timestamp, in seconds, at which refunds become available.
244	    /// @param currentTime Current block Unix timestamp, in seconds.
245	    error RefundsNotAvailable(uint256 deadline, uint256 currentTime);
246	
247	    /// @notice Raised when supplied native value cannot cover the quoted or actual Chainlink request fee.
248	    /// @param requiredFee Native-token wei required for the request.
249	    /// @param suppliedValue Native-token wei supplied by the caller.
250	    error InsufficientVrfFee(uint256 requiredFee, uint256 suppliedValue);
251	
252	    /// @notice Raised when excess native value cannot be returned to the draw requester.
253	    /// @param recipient Draw requester that was due the refund.
254	    /// @param amount Native-token wei that could not be returned.
255	    error NativeRefundFailed(address recipient, uint256 amount);
256	
257	    /// @notice Raised when no current cash-winner proceeds remain claimable.
258	    error NoWinnerProceeds();
259	
260	    /// @notice Raised when no current sponsor proceeds remain claimable.
261	    error NoSponsorProceeds();
262	
263	    /// @notice Raised when no current protocol fees remain claimable.
264	    error NoProtocolFees();
265	
266	    /// @notice Raised when initialization or a ticket transfer targets known protocol plumbing.
267	    /// @param destination Rejected address.
268	    error UnsafeProtocolDestination(address destination);
269	
270	    /// @notice Raised when the caller is not the current owner of the supplied ticket.
271	    /// @param ticketId Ticket whose ownership was checked.
272	    /// @param caller Address attempting the owner-only operation.
273	    /// @param owner Current ticket owner.
274	    error NotTicketOwner(uint256 ticketId, address caller, address owner);
275	
276	    /// @notice Raised when the supplied ticket range does not contain the selected winning entry.
277	    /// @param ticketId Supplied ticket ID.
278	    /// @param winningEntry Selected one-based global winning entry.
279	    error TicketDoesNotContainWinningEntry(uint256 ticketId, uint128 winningEntry);
280	
281	    /// @notice Raised when terminal liabilities have already been allocated.
282	    error SettlementAlreadyComplete();
283	
284	    /// @notice Raised when redemption supplies a ticket other than the recorded winning ticket.

288	
289	    /// @notice Raised when the winning ticket has already been burned and redeemed.
290	    error WinningTicketAlreadyRedeemed();
291	
292	    /// @notice Raised when the sponsor prize cannot be returned in the current result state.
293	    /// @param status Current raffle status.
294	    error SponsorPrizeUnavailable(Status status);
295

2	pragma solidity 0.8.36;
3	
4	/// @title raffle.fun Raffle Factory Interface
5	/// @author heesho
6	/// @notice Defines atomic ERC-1167 raffle creation for one immutable USDC, treasury, and Chainlink configuration.
7	/// @dev The factory has no owner, pause, upgrade, rescue, or mutable protocol configuration. Deployment tooling must
8	///      verify that the immutable quote-token address is the target chain's official USDC; onchain construction checks
9	///      only code presence and six-decimal metadata.
10	/// @custom:version 1.0.0
11	interface IRaffleFactory {
12	    // Types
13	
14	    /// @notice Sponsor-selected configuration for one new raffle.
15	    /// @param sponsorRecipient Immutable recipient of sponsor quote proceeds and any returned prize.
16	    /// @param prizeToken Standards-compliant ERC-721 prize contract.
17	    /// @param prizeTokenId Token ID to escrow atomically during creation.
18	    /// @param reserveEntries Global raw entry-count threshold selecting the NFT outcome when met or exceeded.
19	    /// @param endTime Exclusive sale-end Unix timestamp, in seconds.
20	    struct CreateRaffleParams {
21	        address sponsorRecipient;
22	        address prizeToken;
23	        uint256 prizeTokenId;
24	        uint128 reserveEntries;
25	        uint64 endTime;
26	    }
27	
28	    // Events
29	
30	    /// @notice Emitted after a raffle clone is initialized, registered, funded, and active.

# System Model Dossier: `packages/contracts/src` (raffle.fun v1)

> This document builds context for the hunting phase. It covers structure, state, flows, trust boundaries,
> cross-function invariants, unenforced assumptions and open questions. It does not name vulnerabilities,
> assign severity, propose fixes or describe exploits. An unenforced assumption is recorded as an unenforced
> assumption and nothing more.

---

## 0. Sources, scope and notation

**Scope.** `packages/contracts/src`:

- `RaffleFactory.sol` (186 lines)
- `Raffle.sol` (614)
- `interfaces/IRaffle.sol` (521)
- `interfaces/IRaffleFactory.sol` (150)
- `libraries/RaffleConstants.sol` (43)

Inherited code that is part of the deployed ABI or its behavior is included as context:

- OpenZeppelin Contracts 5.6.1: `ERC721`, `ERC721Utils`, `ReentrancyGuard`, `SafeERC20`, `Math`, `Clones`, `Context`.
- Chainlink contracts 1.5.0: `VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase`, `IVRFV2PlusWrapper`, `VRFV2PlusClient`.

**Inputs:**

- the twelve per-function records (§1.2) under `audit-context/functions/`;
- the orientation supplied with this synthesis task;
- `DESIGN.md`;
- a direct reading of the source for code that has no record (§1.3).

**Build and deployment context:**

- Compiler: solc 0.8.36, EVM `cancun`, optimizer at 200 runs (`foundry.toml` L7-L10; `hardhat.config.ts` L14-L37).
- Configured networks: Sepolia and Ethereum mainnet, both `chainType: "l1"` (`hardhat.config.ts` L38-L57).
- Dependency pins: `package.json` L27-L30. Vendored file hashes: `dependency-hashes.json`.

**Citation key**

| Prefix | File |
| --- | --- |
| bare `Lnnn` | `packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol` |
| `RF` | `src/RaffleFactory.sol` |
| `IR` / `IRF` | `src/interfaces/IRaffle.sol` / `src/interfaces/IRaffleFactory.sol` |
| `RC` | `src/libraries/RaffleConstants.sol` |
| `E` / `U` | OZ `token/ERC721/ERC721.sol` / `token/ERC721/utils/ERC721Utils.sol` |
| `RG` / `SE` / `CL` / `M` | OZ `utils/ReentrancyGuard.sol` / `token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol` / `proxy/Clones.sol` / `utils/math/Math.sol` |
| `VCB` / `IW` | Chainlink `vrf/dev/VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase.sol` / `vrf/dev/interfaces/IVRFV2PlusWrapper.sol` |
| `DESIGN` | `DESIGN.md` (L2 is the whole specification paragraph; L4 is the provenance note) |
| `[NN]` | per-function record `audit-context/functions/NN-*.md` |
| `UA-NN`, `U-NN`, `S-NN`, `W-N`, `CFI-N` | unenforced assumption (§10), open question carried from records (§12.1), open question raised here (§12.2), external-call window (§3.3), cross-function invariant (§6) |

A statement marked **(derived)** is not made by any single record. It combines records, and it cites the records
and lines it rests on.

---

## 1. Inventory

### 1.1 Contracts and roles

| Unit | Role | Mutable state | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `RaffleFactory` | Ownerless, non-upgradeable factory. It is the only caller allowed to initialize a clone, it acts as operator for the prize escrow, and it keeps the clone registry. | `raffleCount`, `raffleById`, `idByRaffle`, `isRaffle`, guard slot | Immutables: `quoteToken`, `vrfWrapper`, `protocolTreasury`, `raffleImplementation` (RF L33-L42). Its only state-changing function is `createRaffle` (RF L97-L148). |
| `Raffle` implementation | Supplies the code for every clone. Its own storage is locked by the constructor. | none in use | Constructor sets `initialized = true` and `status = Refunding` (L164-L165). |
| `Raffle` clone (ERC-1167 proxy, deployed with CREATE) | Escrows one prize NFT, tracks five USDC buckets, issues the "raffle.fun Ticket" ERC-721, and consumes Chainlink VRF v2.5 with native payment. | All Raffle storage, the ERC-721 ledger, its own guard slot | Shares the implementation's immutables `factory`, `quoteToken`, `i_vrfV2PlusWrapper`, `i_linkToken` (L55, L58; VCB L34-L35). |
| `IRaffle`, `IRaffleFactory` | ABI, events, errors, NatSpec | none | Trust-model text lives at IR L12-L15 and IRF L7-L9. |
| `RaffleConstants` | Fixed economics, timing and limits | none | See the table below. |

`RaffleConstants` values (RC L12-L42):

| Constant | Value |
| --- | --- |
| BPS (basis-point denominator) | 10_000 |
| Protocol fee | 500 bps |
| Cash-winner share | 8000 bps |
| Entry price | 1_000_000 (one USDC at 6 decimals) |
| Quote-token decimals | 6 |
| Refund batch limit | 100 tickets |
| Maximum sale duration | 30 days |
| Draw-request timeout | 2 days |
| Callback timeout | 2 days |
| VRF callback gas limit | 300_000 |
| VRF request confirmations | 30 |

| [11] | the `Raffle._update` override, plus the inherited ERC-721 paths that reach it | L497-L502 |
| [12] | `Raffle._isProtocolDestination` | L593-L605 |

### 1.3 Code without a dedicated record

The following code has no record of its own. This dossier describes it from the source and from the records of
its callers and callees.

- `RaffleFactory` constructor (RF L65-L92).
- `RaffleFactory._validateCreateParams` (RF L154-L179). Analysed inside [08].
- `Raffle` constructor (L155-L166).
- `initialize` (L176-L206). Analysed inside [08] and [12].
- `releaseSponsorProceeds` (L375-L382).

- `receive` (L171-L173).
- `_transferQuote` (L564-L567). Analysed inside [01], [04] and [12].
- The views `getVrfRequestPrice`, `estimateVrfRequestPrice`, `ticketRange`, `drawRequestDeadline`,
  `callbackDeadline`, `accountedQuoteBalance` and `grossSales` (L436-L475).

### 1.4 Repository facts that limit what can be resolved

- **No tests, scripts, deployment modules or off-chain consumers exist.**
  - DESIGN L4 says none are provided.
  - `foundry.toml` L3-L4 and `hardhat.config.ts` L9 name `test/` and `script/` directories. Neither exists.
  - `package.json` L15 and L22-L25 reference `scripts/check-coverage.mjs`, `slither.config.json`,
    `ignition/modules/RaffleFun.ts` and `scripts/write-deployment.ts`. None exists.
- **The Chainlink wrapper and coordinator source is not vendored.** `node_modules/@chainlink` contains only
  `IVRFV2PlusWrapper.sol`, `VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase.sol`, `VRFV2PlusClient.sol` and
  `LinkTokenInterface.sol` ([06], [07]).
- **No USDC source exists in the repository** ([03]).
- **A grep over `src` finds no `selfdestruct`, `delegatecall`, `balanceOf`, `this.` call or `fallback`.** This
  matches [03], [10] and [12], and was re-run for this synthesis.

---

135	## 2. Architecture
136	
137	### 2.1 Deployment topology
138	
139	```
140	Deployer ──constructor(quote, wrapper, treasury)──► RaffleFactory   (ownerless; createRaffle is nonReentrant)
141	                                                     │ immutables: quoteToken, vrfWrapper, protocolTreasury,
142	                                                     │             raffleImplementation
143	                                                     │ storage:    raffleCount, raffleById, idByRaffle, isRaffle
144	                                                     ├─ CREATE @ factory nonce 1   ─► Raffle implementation
145	                                                     │                                (initialized=true, status=Refunding)
146	                                                     └─ CREATE @ factory nonce k+1 ─► clone with raffleId k
147	                                                                                     (ERC-1167 → DELEGATECALL to implementation;
148	                                                                                      own storage; shared immutables factory,
149	                                                                                      quoteToken, i_vrfV2PlusWrapper, i_linkToken)
150	Trusted externals:   USDC (quoteToken); Chainlink VRF v2.5 native wrapper (its coordinator is not vendored)
151	Untrusted externals: per-raffle prize ERC-721 (chosen by the sponsor); ticket recipients; draw requester;
152	                     sponsorRecipient
153	```
154	
155	**(derived) Nonce labels.** The nonces in the diagram follow from four facts:
156	
157	- A contract's nonce starts at 1 (EIP-161).
158	- RF L89 (the implementation) and RF L106 (clones) are the factory's only CREATE operations ([12] coupling 2).
159	- RF L89 runs once, in the constructor, and uses nonce 1.
160	- A reverted `createRaffle` rolls back both the `raffleCount` increment (RF L105) and the nonce increment
161	  ([08], [12]).
162	
163	So raffle ID k is always deployed at factory nonce k+1. See CFI-12.
164	
165	### 2.2 Clone ABI surface
166	
167	- **Inheritance.** `Raffle is IRaffle, ERC721, ReentrancyGuard, IERC721Receiver, VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase`
168	  (L28).
169	- **What Raffle overrides:**
170	  - `name` and `symbol` (`pure`, L479-L487);
171	  - `_update` (L497);
172	  - `fulfillRandomWords` (L509);
173	  - `onERC721Received` (L416).
174	- **What Raffle does not override:** `_ownerOf`, `transferFrom`, `safeTransferFrom`, `approve`,
175	  `setApprovalForAll`, `_msgSender` ([11]).
176	- **Guarded mutators.** These nine share one reentrancy slot per clone (RG L36-L37):
177	
178	  | Function | Line |
179	  | --- | --- |
180	  | `buyEntries` | L212 |
181	  | `requestDraw` | L240 |
182	  | `enableRefunds` | L276 |
183	  | `settleWinningTicket` | L304 |
184	  | `redeemWinningTicket` | L309 |
185	  | `refundTickets` | L349 |
186	  | `releaseSponsorProceeds` | L375 |
187	  | `releaseProtocolFees` | L385 |
188	  | `releaseSponsorPrize` | L395 |
189	
190	- **Unguarded external entry points:**
191	  - `initialize` (L176);
192	  - `onERC721Received` (L416);
193	  - `rawFulfillRandomWords` (VCB L101);
194	  - the ERC-721 functions `approve`, `setApprovalForAll`, `transferFrom` and both `safeTransferFrom` overloads
195	    (E L93-L136);
196	  - `receive`, which always reverts (L171-L173);
197	  - views, including the inherited `getBalance`, `getLinkToken`, `i_vrfV2PlusWrapper`, and `supportsInterface`
198	    (which reports IERC721, IERC721Metadata and IERC165, E L45-L50).
199	
200	  There is no `fallback`.
201	- **Fresh clones.** A new clone's guard slot holds 0. The guard treats 0 as "not entered" because it only tests
202	  for the ENTERED value, 2 (RG L112-L114; [09]).
203	
204	### 2.3 Lifecycle state machine
205	
206	```
207	                         initialize (L205; factory-only, once)
208	 fresh clone (status 0) ─────────────────────────────────────► AwaitingPrize
209	                                                                   │ onERC721Received (L428), only inside RF L128
210	                                                                   ▼
211	            ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────  Active  ────────────────────────────────────┐
212	            │ requestDraw (L252)                                    │ enableRefunds (L299)                    │
213	            │ E ≤ t < E+2d, totalEntries ≥ 1, fee paid              │ no sales: sponsor any t, or anyone t ≥ E │
214	            ▼                                                       │ sold:     anyone t ≥ E+2d               ▼
215	         Drawing ── enableRefunds (L299), anyone, t ≥ R+2d ─────────────────────────────────────────►  Refunding
216	            │ fulfillRandomWords (L521): wrapper only, t < R+2d, id match, 1 word, not in flight
217	            ▼
218	  NftWon (totalEntries ≥ reserveEntries)   or   CashWon (totalEntries < reserveEntries)
219	
220	  Implementation instance: the constructor writes Refunding (L165). It has no outgoing transition.
221	  E = endTime, R = drawRequestedAt, t = block.timestamp.
222	```
223	
224	| Transition | Written at | Function | Gate | Caller |
225	| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
226	| deploy → Refunding | L165 | constructor | implementation only | factory constructor (RF L89) |
227	| fresh → AwaitingPrize | L205 | `initialize` | `!initialized` (L177) and `msg.sender == factory` (L178) | the factory, inside `createRaffle` (RF L109-L121) |
228	| AwaitingPrize → Active | L428 | `onERC721Received` | status, `msg.sender == prizeToken`, `tokenId`, `from == sponsor`, `operator == factory` (L421-L426) | the prize contract, inside RF L128 ([09]) |
229	| Active → Drawing | L252 | `requestDraw` | L241-L250 | anyone who pays the fee |
230	| Drawing → NftWon or CashWon | L521 | `fulfillRandomWords` | VCB L103; L510-L513 | the VRF wrapper |
231	| Active → Refunding | L299 | `enableRefunds` | L279-L288 | the sponsor or anyone (timing in §7) |
232	| Drawing → Refunding | L299 | `enableRefunds` | L289-L291 | anyone |
233	
234	NftWon, CashWon and Refunding are absorbing. Every status writer requires a non-terminal source state (L177,
235	L241, L279-L294, L422, L511; [01] precondition table; [05] invariant 2).
236	
237	### 2.4 Function availability by status (clone)
238	
239	| Function | AwaitingPrize | Active | Drawing | NftWon | CashWon | Refunding |
240	| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
241	| `initialize` | fresh clone only (factory, once) | no | no | no | no | no |
242	| `onERC721Received` | prize contract with matching arguments | no | no | no | no | no |
243	| `buyEntries` | no | while t < E | no | no | no | no |
244	| `requestDraw` | no | while E ≤ t < E+2d, with at least one entry sold | no | no | no | no |
245	| `enableRefunds` | no | no sales: sponsor at any t, anyone at t ≥ E. Sold: anyone at t ≥ E+2d. | anyone at t ≥ R+2d | no | no | no |
246	| `rawFulfillRandomWords` (wrapper only) | ignored | ignored | resolves if L510-L513 all pass, otherwise ignored | ignored | ignored | ignored |
247	| `settleWinningTicket` | no | no | no | once | once | no |
248	| `redeemWinningTicket` | no | no | no | ticket owner, once | ticket owner, once | no |
249	| `refundTickets` | no | no | no | no | no | ticket owners |
250	| `releaseSponsorProceeds`, `releaseProtocolFees` | (0) | (0) | (0) | once each, after settlement | once each, after settlement | (0) |
251	| `releaseSponsorPrize` | no | no | no | no | once | once |
252	| ERC-721 transfers and approvals | (no tickets exist) | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
253	
254	How to read the table:
255	
256	- **(0):** the function has no status gate. It reverts on a zero balance, and the balance is always zero in that
257	  status (CFI-2).
258	- **Ignored:** the callback emits `VrfCallbackIgnored` and returns. It writes no state and does not revert (L514;
259	  [06]).
260	- **Wrapper only:** callers other than the wrapper revert at VCB L103.
261	
262	### 2.5 Asset channels
263	
264	**USDC** (accounted nominally)
265	
266	- **Inflow.** `buyEntries` at L224: the payer sends `entryCount × 1e6` to the clone.
267	- **Outflows.** All go through `_transferQuote` (L564-L567), which screens the destination at payout time:
268	  - `refundTickets` L369, to the caller;
269	  - `redeemWinningTicket` L342, to the winner;
270	  - `releaseSponsorProceeds` L380, to `sponsorRecipient`;
271	  - `releaseProtocolFees` L390, to `protocolTreasury`.
272	- **Inflows outside these paths.** Direct transfers, and USDC sent to a future clone address before deployment.
273	  They create no liability and have no exit ([04], shared state).
274	
275	**Prize NFT**
276	
277	- **Inflow.** RF L128: sponsor to clone, moved by the prize contract. Both the acceptance (L422-L423) and the
278	  check (RF L129) rest on the prize contract's own reports.
279	- **Outflows.** Neither re-screens the destination.
280	  - `redeemWinningTicket` L334, to the winner (NftWon).
281	  - `releaseSponsorPrize` L404, to `sponsorRecipient` (CashWon, Refunding).
282	- **Inflows outside these paths.**
283	  - Other NFTs sent with plain `transferFrom`: unaccounted, with no exit (L409-L411).
284	  - Other NFTs sent with `safeTransferFrom`: rejected (L421-L426).
285	
286	**Native ETH**
287	
288	- **Inflow.** `requestDraw` `msg.value`.
289	- **Outflows.** VCB L84, `paidPrice` to the wrapper; L267, `excess` to `msg.sender`. On success the two add up
290	  to `msg.value` ([07]).
291	- **Inflows outside these paths.** Forced sends. A successful call never spends them, and they have no exit
292	  ([07]).
293	
294	**Tickets** (these are claims, not escrowed assets)
295	
296	- Minted at L235.
297	- Burned at L325 (winner) and L364 (refund).
298	
299	---
300	
301	## 3. Actors, trust boundaries and reach
302	
303	### 3.1 Actor table
304	
305	Trust labels follow the orientation. "Reaches in turn" lists what an actor's calls go on to execute.
306	
307	| Actor | Trust | Entrypoints | Reaches in turn | Records |
308	| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
309	| Factory deployer | trusted | RF constructor | `quoteToken.decimals()` (try/catch); `new Raffle`, whose consumer-base constructor calls `wrapper.link()` (VCB L45); fixes every immutable. No powers after deployment. | none (source) |
310	| `RaffleFactory` contract | trusted | its own functions | Only caller of `initialize` (L178); acts as prize-escrow operator (RF L128); its registry is read by every clone (L601, L603) | [08], [12] |
311	| Chainlink VRF wrapper and coordinator | trusted | `rawFulfillRandomWords` | `fulfillRandomWords`, which has no guard and makes no external calls. Only writer of NftWon and CashWon. | [06], [07] |
312	| USDC | trusted | called at L224 and L566 | If it ever called back, only unguarded functions would be reachable. No callback is expected. | [03], [04] |
313	| Protocol treasury | trusted, passive | none required | Receives L390 (screened at payout, L565) | [12] |
314	| Sponsor (`createRaffle` caller) | semi-trusted | `createRaffle`; `enableRefunds` while no entries are sold | Chooses the prize contract, whose code runs inside RF L128 (W1); may close a raffle with no sales at any time (L282) | [05], [08], [09] |
315	| Sponsor recipient | untrusted, passive | none required | Receives USDC at L380 (screened at release) and the NFT at L404 (not screened at release; plain `transferFrom`, so no receiver hook) | [10], [12] |
316	| Prize ERC-721 contract | untrusted | calls `onERC721Received` as `msg.sender`; is called at RF L172, L128, L129 and at L334/L335, L404/L405 | Only writer of Active, based on its own report. Answers every custody check. Runs in W1 (clone Active and unguarded), W6 and W10 (clone guarded). | [01], [08], [09], [10] |
317	| Entry buyer / payer | untrusted | `buyEntries` | USDC pull; ticket mint; recipient hook in W3. Any payer can move `totalEntries` toward `reserveEntries`, including the sponsor, the sponsor recipient or the treasury. | [03] |
318	| Ticket recipient contract | untrusted | `onERC721Received` callbacks | W3 (clone guard held) or W11 (top-level transfer: guard not held) | [11] |
319	| Ticket holder | untrusted | `refundTickets`, `redeemWinningTicket`, ERC-721 transfers | USDC payout to itself (screened); prize delivery through the prize contract (W6) | [01], [04], [11] |
320	| Approved operator / per-token approvee | untrusted | ERC-721 transfers and approvals | Cannot refund or redeem in the same call, but can transfer the ticket to itself and then claim as owner | [01], [04], [11] |
321	| Draw requester | untrusted | `requestDraw` (payable) | Wrapper request carrying value (W4); full-gas refund call back to itself (W5); chooses the `tx.gasprice` that sets the fee | [07] |
322	| Permissionless keeper | untrusted | `enableRefunds` (after deadlines), `settleWinningTicket`, `releaseSponsorProceeds`, `releaseProtocolFees`, `releaseSponsorPrize` | Fixed-destination payouts; the prize contract via L404 (W10). Chooses only when these run, never where value goes. | [02], [05], [10] |
323	| Frontend / indexer | untrusted, advisory | views and events | none. See CFI-16 for flags and events that can run ahead of custody. | [03], [08], [09], [11] |
324	| Deployer of third-party proxies (not in the orientation) | untrusted | `Clones.clone(raffleImplementation)` from any contract | Proxies that can never be initialized (L178), are not registered, and pass the destination screens as ordinary contracts | [08], [12] |
325	
326	### 3.2 Guard domains
327	
328	- **Slots.** Each clone has one guard slot, shared by its nine guarded mutators. The factory has a separate slot
329	  that guards only `createRaffle`.
330	- **Guards do not span contracts.**
331	  - While `createRaffle` runs (factory slot ENTERED), every clone's guarded functions stay callable. That
332	    includes the new clone, whose slot is 0.
333	  - While a clone's guarded function runs, the factory's `createRaffle` and every function of every other clone
334	    stay callable ([08], [09], [11]).
335	- **Factory getters.** `raffleImplementation()` and `isRaffle()` have no guard (`nonReentrantView` at RG L83 is
336	  not used). Clone screens therefore keep working while the factory slot is ENTERED ([12]).
337	
338	### 3.3 External-call windows
339	
340	Each row is a point where control leaves the contract. "Committed" lists what the enclosing call has already
341	written. "Reachable" lists what code running at that point can still reach, meaning it is not blocked by a guard
342	or by a state gate.
343	
344	| ID | Site | Callee (trust) | Guards during the call | Committed before the call | Reachable from inside | Records |
345	| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
346	| W1 | RF L128 `prize.safeTransferFrom` | prize contract (untrusted) | factory ENTERED; new clone 0 | `raffleCount`; registry including `isRaffle[clone]`; clone configuration; `AwaitingPrize`. After L428 runs: `Active`. | `onERC721Received` (the only writer of Active). Once Active: `buyEntries` (payer needs an allowance to the new clone); ticket ERC-721 functions; `enableRefunds` called from the sponsor address, then `releaseSponsorPrize`; all functions of other clones; factory getters. Not reachable: `createRaffle`. Reverting: `requestDraw` and `enableRefunds` from anyone except the sponsor (t < E). | [08], [09], [05], [10] |
347	| W2 | L224 `USDC.transferFrom` | USDC (trusted) | clone ENTERED | Nothing from this purchase; L230-L233 come after. | Unguarded functions only. No callback is expected. [05] notes that the guard is the only thing stopping a sponsor `enableRefunds` during the first purchase's pull. | [03], [05] |
348	| W3 | L235 → E L289 → `recipient.onERC721Received` | ticket recipient (untrusted) | clone ENTERED | Totals, range and pot (L230-L233); ticket owner (E L240) | Ticket ERC-721 functions (it can move the new ticket before L236 emits); other clones; `createRaffle`, unless this frame is nested inside W1 | [03], [11] |
349	| W4 | VCB L84 `wrapper.requestRandomWordsInNative{value}` | wrapper (trusted) | clone ENTERED | `Drawing`; `drawRequestedAt`; `_requestInFlight = true`. `vrfRequestId` is still 0. | A synchronous `rawFulfillRandomWords` is ignored at L511. | [07], [06] |
350	| W5 | L267 raw `call{value: excess}` to `msg.sender` (all gas, empty calldata) | draw requester (untrusted) | clone ENTERED | `Drawing`; `drawRequestedAt`; `vrfRequestId`; `_requestInFlight = false` | Unguarded ticket functions; other clones; `createRaffle`. A matching wrapper callback arriving here would be accepted by L510-L513; nothing in the repo excludes it (UA-26, UA-30). | [07], [06], [11] |
351	| W6 | L334 `prize.transferFrom`; L335 `ownerOf` (STATICCALL) | prize contract (untrusted) | clone ENTERED | Inline settlement (if it ran); `winnerRecipient`; `winnerRedeemed`; the burn; `prizeClaimed` | Unguarded functions on other tickets; other clones; `createRaffle`. `onERC721Received` reverts on status; `rawFulfillRandomWords` would be ignored. | [01], [11] |
352	| W7 | L566 via L342, `USDC.transfer` to the winner | USDC (trusted) | clone ENTERED | `winnerProceeds = 0`; the burn; flags | none expected | [01] |
353	| W8 | L566 via L369, `USDC.transfer` to the refunding owner | USDC (trusted) | clone ENTERED | The burns; the liability debit | none expected | [04] |
354	| W9 | L566 via L380 or L390 | USDC (trusted) | clone ENTERED | The bucket set to zero | none expected | [12] |
355	| W10 | L404 `prize.transferFrom`; L405 `ownerOf` | prize contract (untrusted) | clone ENTERED | `prizeClaimed = true` | Same as W6 | [10], [11] |
356	| W11 | E L135 → `recipient.onERC721Received`, after a ticket `safeTransferFrom` | ticket recipient (untrusted) | Whatever the enclosing frame holds. For a top-level transfer, the clone guard is not entered. | Ownership already moved; approval cleared | For a top-level transfer: every clone function, including guarded ones, as the new owner (it can refund or redeem inside the callback). | [11], [01], [05] |
357	| W12 | RF L172 `supportsInterface`; RF L129 `ownerOf`; L335 and L405 `ownerOf` | prize contract (untrusted, STATICCALL) | n/a | n/a | Read-only. It can revert, burn gas, or return any value. | [08], [01], [10] |
358	| W13 | factory getters (L601, L603); wrapper quotes (L437, L442, VCB L82); `link()` (VCB L45, implementation deployment only) | trusted (STATICCALL, except `link()` during construction) | n/a | n/a | n/a | [12], [07] |
359	
360	### 3.4 Transitive reach
361	
362	- **(derived) Registry growth.** `RaffleFactory.createRaffle` is the only operation that changes state every
363	  clone shares (`isRaffle`). Untrusted code can call it from any window except W1, because the factory guard is
364	  per factory and only W1 runs under it ([08]; [12] coupling 2; RF L97).
365	- **From W1.** Code cannot call `createRaffle`, but it can act on the new clone as an ordinary user would, with
366	  the clone Active and its guard open.
367	- **No clone calls another raffle.** Clones call only:
368	  - USDC;
369	  - the wrapper;
370	  - their own prize contract;
371	  - the factory getters;
372	  - the `requestDraw` caller (empty calldata);
373	  - ERC-721 receiver hooks.
374	
375	  ([11] coupling 1; [12] coupling 4.) Interaction between clones therefore happens only through untrusted actors
376	  and the shared registry.
377	
378	---

            │ requestDraw (L252)                                    │ enableRefunds (L299)                    │
            │ E ≤ t < E+2d, totalEntries ≥ 1, fee paid              │ no sales: sponsor any t, or anyone t ≥ E │
            ▼                                                       │ sold:     anyone t ≥ E+2d               ▼
         Drawing ── enableRefunds (L299), anyone, t ≥ R+2d ─────────────────────────────────────────►  Refunding
            │ fulfillRandomWords (L521): wrapper only, t < R+2d, id match, 1 word, not in flight
            ▼
  NftWon (totalEntries ≥ reserveEntries)   or   CashWon (totalEntries < reserveEntries)

  Implementation instance: the constructor writes Refunding (L165). It has no outgoing transition.
  E = endTime, R = drawRequestedAt, t = block.timestamp.
```

| Transition | Written at | Function | Gate | Caller |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| deploy → Refunding | L165 | constructor | implementation only | factory constructor (RF L89) |
| fresh → AwaitingPrize | L205 | `initialize` | `!initialized` (L177) and `msg.sender == factory` (L178) | the factory, inside `createRaffle` (RF L109-L121) |
| AwaitingPrize → Active | L428 | `onERC721Received` | status, `msg.sender == prizeToken`, `tokenId`, `from == sponsor`, `operator == factory` (L421-L426) | the prize contract, inside RF L128 ([09]) |
| Active → Drawing | L252 | `requestDraw` | L241-L250 | anyone who pays the fee |
| Drawing → NftWon or CashWon | L521 | `fulfillRandomWords` | VCB L103; L510-L513 | the VRF wrapper |
| Active → Refunding | L299 | `enableRefunds` | L279-L288 | the sponsor or anyone (timing in §7) |
| Drawing → Refunding | L299 | `enableRefunds` | L289-L291 | anyone |

NftWon, CashWon and Refunding are absorbing. Every status writer requires a non-terminal source state (L177,
L241, L279-L294, L422, L511; [01] precondition table; [05] invariant 2).

### 2.4 Function availability by status (clone)

| Function | AwaitingPrize | Active | Drawing | NftWon | CashWon | Refunding |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `initialize` | fresh clone only (factory, once) | no | no | no | no | no |
| `onERC721Received` | prize contract with matching arguments | no | no | no | no | no |
| `buyEntries` | no | while t < E | no | no | no | no |
| `requestDraw` | no | while E ≤ t < E+2d, with at least one entry sold | no | no | no | no |
| `enableRefunds` | no | no sales: sponsor at any t, anyone at t ≥ E. Sold: anyone at t ≥ E+2d. | anyone at t ≥ R+2d | no | no | no |
| `rawFulfillRandomWords` (wrapper only) | ignored | ignored | resolves if L510-L513 all pass, otherwise ignored | ignored | ignored | ignored |
| `settleWinningTicket` | no | no | no | once | once | no |
| `redeemWinningTicket` | no | no | no | ticket owner, once | ticket owner, once | no |
| `refundTickets` | no | no | no | no | no | ticket owners |
| `releaseSponsorProceeds`, `releaseProtocolFees` | (0) | (0) | (0) | once each, after settlement | once each, after settlement | (0) |
| `releaseSponsorPrize` | no | no | no | no | once | once |
| ERC-721 transfers and approvals | (no tickets exist) | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

How to read the table:

- **(0):** the function has no status gate. It reverts on a zero balance, and the balance is always zero in that
  status (CFI-2).
- **Ignored:** the callback emits `VrfCallbackIgnored` and returns. It writes no state and does not revert (L514;
  [06]).
- **Wrapper only:** callers other than the wrapper revert at VCB L103.

### 2.5 Asset channels

**USDC** (accounted nominally)

- **Inflow.** `buyEntries` at L224: the payer sends `entryCount × 1e6` to the clone.
- **Outflows.** All go through `_transferQuote` (L564-L567), which screens the destination at payout time:
  - `refundTickets` L369, to the caller;
  - `redeemWinningTicket` L342, to the winner;
  - `releaseSponsorProceeds` L380, to `sponsorRecipient`;
  - `releaseProtocolFees` L390, to `protocolTreasury`.
- **Inflows outside these paths.** Direct transfers, and USDC sent to a future clone address before deployment.
  They create no liability and have no exit ([04], shared state).

**Prize NFT**

- **Inflow.** RF L128: sponsor to clone, moved by the prize contract. Both the acceptance (L422-L423) and the
  check (RF L129) rest on the prize contract's own reports.
- **Outflows.** Neither re-screens the destination.
  - `redeemWinningTicket` L334, to the winner (NftWon).
  - `releaseSponsorPrize` L404, to `sponsorRecipient` (CashWon, Refunding).
- **Inflows outside these paths.**
  - Other NFTs sent with plain `transferFrom`: unaccounted, with no exit (L409-L411).
  - Other NFTs sent with `safeTransferFrom`: rejected (L421-L426).

**Native ETH**

- **Inflow.** `requestDraw` `msg.value`.
- **Outflows.** VCB L84, `paidPrice` to the wrapper; L267, `excess` to `msg.sender`. On success the two add up
  to `msg.value` ([07]).
- **Inflows outside these paths.** Forced sends. A successful call never spends them, and they have no exit
  ([07]).

**Tickets** (these are claims, not escrowed assets)

- Minted at L235.
- Burned at L325 (winner) and L364 (refund).

---

## 3. Actors, trust boundaries and reach

### 3.1 Actor table

Trust labels follow the orientation. "Reaches in turn" lists what an actor's calls go on to execute.

| Actor | Trust | Entrypoints | Reaches in turn | Records |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Factory deployer | trusted | RF constructor | `quoteToken.decimals()` (try/catch); `new Raffle`, whose consumer-base constructor calls `wrapper.link()` (VCB L45); fixes every immutable. No powers after deployment. | none (source) |
| `RaffleFactory` contract | trusted | its own functions | Only caller of `initialize` (L178); acts as prize-escrow operator (RF L128); its registry is read by every clone (L601, L603) | [08], [12] |
| Chainlink VRF wrapper and coordinator | trusted | `rawFulfillRandomWords` | `fulfillRandomWords`, which has no guard and makes no external calls. Only writer of NftWon and CashWon. | [06], [07] |
| USDC | trusted | called at L224 and L566 | If it ever called back, only unguarded functions would be reachable. No callback is expected. | [03], [04] |
| Protocol treasury | trusted, passive | none required | Receives L390 (screened at payout, L565) | [12] |
| Sponsor (`createRaffle` caller) | semi-trusted | `createRaffle`; `enableRefunds` while no entries are sold | Chooses the prize contract, whose code runs inside RF L128 (W1); may close a raffle with no sales at any time (L282) | [05], [08], [09] |
| Sponsor recipient | untrusted, passive | none required | Receives USDC at L380 (screened at release) and the NFT at L404 (not screened at release; plain `transferFrom`, so no receiver hook) | [10], [12] |
| Prize ERC-721 contract | untrusted | calls `onERC721Received` as `msg.sender`; is called at RF L172, L128, L129 and at L334/L335, L404/L405 | Only writer of Active, based on its own report. Answers every custody check. Runs in W1 (clone Active and unguarded), W6 and W10 (clone guarded). | [01], [08], [09], [10] |
| Entry buyer / payer | untrusted | `buyEntries` | USDC pull; ticket mint; recipient hook in W3. Any payer can move `totalEntries` toward `reserveEntries`, including the sponsor, the sponsor recipient or the treasury. | [03] |
| Ticket recipient contract | untrusted | `onERC721Received` callbacks | W3 (clone guard held) or W11 (top-level transfer: guard not held) | [11] |
| Ticket holder | untrusted | `refundTickets`, `redeemWinningTicket`, ERC-721 transfers | USDC payout to itself (screened); prize delivery through the prize contract (W6) | [01], [04], [11] |
| Approved operator / per-token approvee | untrusted | ERC-721 transfers and approvals | Cannot refund or redeem in the same call, but can transfer the ticket to itself and then claim as owner | [01], [04], [11] |
| Draw requester | untrusted | `requestDraw` (payable) | Wrapper request carrying value (W4); full-gas refund call back to itself (W5); chooses the `tx.gasprice` that sets the fee | [07] |
| Permissionless keeper | untrusted | `enableRefunds` (after deadlines), `settleWinningTicket`, `releaseSponsorProceeds`, `releaseProtocolFees`, `releaseSponsorPrize` | Fixed-destination payouts; the prize contract via L404 (W10). Chooses only when these run, never where value goes. | [02], [05], [10] |
| Frontend / indexer | untrusted, advisory | views and events | none. See CFI-16 for flags and events that can run ahead of custody. | [03], [08], [09], [11] |
| Deployer of third-party proxies (not in the orientation) | untrusted | `Clones.clone(raffleImplementation)` from any contract | Proxies that can never be initialized (L178), are not registered, and pass the destination screens as ordinary contracts | [08], [12] |

### 3.2 Guard domains

- **Slots.** Each clone has one guard slot, shared by its nine guarded mutators. The factory has a separate slot
  that guards only `createRaffle`.
- **Guards do not span contracts.**
  - While `createRaffle` runs (factory slot ENTERED), every clone's guarded functions stay callable. That
    includes the new clone, whose slot is 0.
  - While a clone's guarded function runs, the factory's `createRaffle` and every function of every other clone
    stay callable ([08], [09], [11]).
- **Factory getters.** `raffleImplementation()` and `isRaffle()` have no guard (`nonReentrantView` at RG L83 is
  not used). Clone screens therefore keep working while the factory slot is ENTERED ([12]).

### 3.3 External-call windows

Each row is a point where control leaves the contract. "Committed" lists what the enclosing call has already
written. "Reachable" lists what code running at that point can still reach, meaning it is not blocked by a guard
or by a state gate.

| ID | Site | Callee (trust) | Guards during the call | Committed before the call | Reachable from inside | Records |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| W1 | RF L128 `prize.safeTransferFrom` | prize contract (untrusted) | factory ENTERED; new clone 0 | `raffleCount`; registry including `isRaffle[clone]`; clone configuration; `AwaitingPrize`. After L428 runs: `Active`. | `onERC721Received` (the only writer of Active). Once Active: `buyEntries` (payer needs an allowance to the new clone); ticket ERC-721 functions; `enableRefunds` called from the sponsor address, then `releaseSponsorPrize`; all functions of other clones; factory getters. Not reachable: `createRaffle`. Reverting: `requestDraw` and `enableRefunds` from anyone except the sponsor (t < E). | [08], [09], [05], [10] |
| W2 | L224 `USDC.transferFrom` | USDC (trusted) | clone ENTERED | Nothing from this purchase; L230-L233 come after. | Unguarded functions only. No callback is expected. [05] notes that the guard is the only thing stopping a sponsor `enableRefunds` during the first purchase's pull. | [03], [05] |
| W3 | L235 → E L289 → `recipient.onERC721Received` | ticket recipient (untrusted) | clone ENTERED | Totals, range and pot (L230-L233); ticket owner (E L240) | Ticket ERC-721 functions (it can move the new ticket before L236 emits); other clones; `createRaffle`, unless this frame is nested inside W1 | [03], [11] |
| W4 | VCB L84 `wrapper.requestRandomWordsInNative{value}` | wrapper (trusted) | clone ENTERED | `Drawing`; `drawRequestedAt`; `_requestInFlight = true`. `vrfRequestId` is still 0. | A synchronous `rawFulfillRandomWords` is ignored at L511. | [07], [06] |
| W5 | L267 raw `call{value: excess}` to `msg.sender` (all gas, empty calldata) | draw requester (untrusted) | clone ENTERED | `Drawing`; `drawRequestedAt`; `vrfRequestId`; `_requestInFlight = false` | Unguarded ticket functions; other clones; `createRaffle`. A matching wrapper callback arriving here would be accepted by L510-L513; nothing in the repo excludes it (UA-26, UA-30). | [07], [06], [11] |
| W6 | L334 `prize.transferFrom`; L335 `ownerOf` (STATICCALL) | prize contract (untrusted) | clone ENTERED | Inline settlement (if it ran); `winnerRecipient`; `winnerRedeemed`; the burn; `prizeClaimed` | Unguarded functions on other tickets; other clones; `createRaffle`. `onERC721Received` reverts on status; `rawFulfillRandomWords` would be ignored. | [01], [11] |
| W7 | L566 via L342, `USDC.transfer` to the winner | USDC (trusted) | clone ENTERED | `winnerProceeds = 0`; the burn; flags | none expected | [01] |
| W8 | L566 via L369, `USDC.transfer` to the refunding owner | USDC (trusted) | clone ENTERED | The burns; the liability debit | none expected | [04] |
| W9 | L566 via L380 or L390 | USDC (trusted) | clone ENTERED | The bucket set to zero | none expected | [12] |
| W10 | L404 `prize.transferFrom`; L405 `ownerOf` | prize contract (untrusted) | clone ENTERED | `prizeClaimed = true` | Same as W6 | [10], [11] |
| W11 | E L135 → `recipient.onERC721Received`, after a ticket `safeTransferFrom` | ticket recipient (untrusted) | Whatever the enclosing frame holds. For a top-level transfer, the clone guard is not entered. | Ownership already moved; approval cleared | For a top-level transfer: every clone function, including guarded ones, as the new owner (it can refund or redeem inside the callback). | [11], [01], [05] |
| W12 | RF L172 `supportsInterface`; RF L129 `ownerOf`; L335 and L405 `ownerOf` | prize contract (untrusted, STATICCALL) | n/a | n/a | Read-only. It can revert, burn gas, or return any value. | [08], [01], [10] |
| W13 | factory getters (L601, L603); wrapper quotes (L437, L442, VCB L82); `link()` (VCB L45, implementation deployment only) | trusted (STATICCALL, except `link()` during construction) | n/a | n/a | n/a | [12], [07] |

### 3.4 Transitive reach

- **(derived) Registry growth.** `RaffleFactory.createRaffle` is the only operation that changes state every
  clone shares (`isRaffle`). Untrusted code can call it from any window except W1, because the factory guard is
  per factory and only W1 runs under it ([08]; [12] coupling 2; RF L97).
- **From W1.** Code cannot call `createRaffle`, but it can act on the new clone as an ordinary user would, with
  the clone Active and its guard open.
- **No clone calls another raffle.** Clones call only:
  - USDC;
  - the wrapper;
  - their own prize contract;
  - the factory getters;
  - the `requestDraw` caller (empty calldata);
  - ERC-721 receiver hooks.

  ([11] coupling 1; [12] coupling 4.) Interaction between clones therefore happens only through untrusted actors
  and the shared registry.

    emit DrawRequested(requestId, msg.sender, paidPrice, excess, drawRequestedAt, callbackDeadline());

```

**Purpose:** `requestDraw` is the only transition from `Active` to `Drawing`. L252 is the only line in the codebase that writes `Status.Drawing` (grep of `status\s*=` returns L165, L205, L252, L299, L428, L521). It does four things:

- Commits the raffle to exactly one Chainlink VRF v2.5 native-payment request.
- Records the request timestamp (`drawRequestedAt`, L253). That timestamp anchors the callback window used by `fulfillRandomWords` (L512) and by the `Drawing` branch of `enableRefunds` (L290).
- Records the request ID (`vrfRequestId`, L259). `fulfillRandomWords` matches incoming callbacks against it (L511).
- Makes the caller fund the native fee, returning any surplus to them.

Without this function a sold raffle has one path out of `Active`: `enableRefunds` once `block.timestamp >= endTime + 2 days` (L285-L288). `NftWon` and `CashWon` can only be reached after a successful `requestDraw`, because `fulfillRandomWords` resolves only while `status == Drawing` (L511).

---

## 7. Timeline model

E = `endTime`, R = `drawRequestedAt`, d = 172,800 seconds (two days). Both timeouts are 2 d (RC L33, L36).

| Time t | Active, no sales | Active, sold | Drawing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| creation ≤ t < E | `buyEntries`; sponsor `enableRefunds` | `buyEntries` | cannot be Drawing yet (Drawing needs t ≥ E) |
| E ≤ t < E+2d | anyone may call `enableRefunds` | only `requestDraw` can leave Active | callback accepted while t < R+2d |
| t ≥ E+2d | anyone may call `enableRefunds` | anyone may call `enableRefunds` | callback accepted while t < R+2d; `enableRefunds` from R+2d, which is before E+4d |

- **Boundaries.** Each one compares the same `block.timestamp` against the same deadline function on both sides
  (CFI-8). DESIGN L2 ("Request window [sale end, end+2days); callback accepted strictly before request
  timestamp+2days. Refunds open at deadline") matches the code ([05] documentation alignment).
- **Creation.** RF L100-L104 keep `requestDraw` closed, and `enableRefunds` closed to everyone except the sponsor,
  for the whole creation transaction ([08] time coupling).
- **Terminal states** have no time conditions.
- **Unenforced environmental premises:** UA-28 and UA-34 (`uint64` timestamp conversions); U-15
  (block-timestamp rules).

---

`_isProtocolDestination(destination, prizeToken_)` (L593-L605) returns true when:

- it equals `factory.raffleImplementation()` (L601). This STATICCALL is made only if all five local comparisons
  miss; or
- it has code and `factory.isRaffle(destination)` is true (L602-L603).
